text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――! Crossing the line in first place in 
her Make Debut is this Umamusume! A clean, 
decisive run right from her first race!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...The sensation still remains, along 
with the scenery as I crossed the finish 
line.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ha... ahaha...! So this is the turf... 
of a racecourse...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big sis! That was amazing--!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Su-chan, Lu-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Did you... watch me... give it my all...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! My heart was pounding so fast! 
Like whoaaa, and I'm still kind of...

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Amaaaziiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah...! *pant*... Big Sis is... the 
sa... me...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Because my own heart is still thumping 
wildly in my chest.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(It's beating so loud that other people 
might hear it. Thump-thump, 
thump-thump...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(It feels just like when that emotion was 
first born.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on TV
text_block_list.text:
"—Ever since I was born an Umamusume, 
becoming a Derby Umamusume has been my 
dream."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The live broadcast of the Japan Derby was 
playing on TV at home. I was doing 
laundry, right as I finished hanging up my 
little sister's hoodie.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Smiling amidst the roar of the crowd, the 
Derby Umamusume was covered in mud, yet 
looked completely overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There was a clatter as a hanger fell to 
the floor.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
After the broadcast ended, I rushed over 
to the local second-hand bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What I picked up was the magazine I'd had 
my eye on for a while. The one with 'Derby 
Special' written across the cover.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
With my heart pounding loudly in my chest, 
I stood there reading until the sun went 
down—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in the Magazine Interview
text_block_list.text:
"—Ever since I was born an Umamusume, 
there has been only one title I've strived 
for."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Ever since the day I saw that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then. Deep in my heart, I've 
always...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the debut race. Having seen Ines 
Fujin's younger sisters safely off, I head 
back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on today's result, which Open race 
should we enter next? As I ponder over the 
possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Put me in the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to win the Derby! I want to 
go to the Derby and feel my heart 
pounding!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've always dreamed of that stage every 
Umamusume yearns for too. I wanted to run 
in the Derby, and—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her sheer momentum took me completely 
by surprise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In stark contrast to her usual sunny, 
gentle demeanor, flames seemed to burn 
fiercely in her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"What should I do to make that happen? 
What do you think I need?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What's missing first is experience and 
competitive instinct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you want her to acquire those as 
quickly as possible, one option is to 
challenge the GⅠ races where Umamusume 
aiming for the Junior crown gather."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For example, there is the Asahi Hai FS— 
the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes— but...
choice_data_list:
(...Still, aiming for a GⅠ right off the 
bat is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm a rookie Trainer, and she's an 
Umamusume fresh off her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Junior Class GⅠs are stages packed with 
Umamusume blessed with pure natural 
talent. Many of them have been running 
ever since they were young children.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering our current skillset, it might 
be a goal far beyond our means.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: What should I do next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Yet, looking into those earnest eyes of 
hers, the only proper answer I can give is 
to face her head-on.
choice_data_list:
Why don't we give the "Asahi Hai FS" a 
try?
Want to try entering the "Asahi Hai FS"?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
! Understood, the Asahi Hai FS, right?! 
I'll start getting ready right away!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her response, I also braced my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS... A 1600m turf mile race 
to determine the Junior-class champion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help her win the Derby, let's have her 
gain the experience she needs right there!
